steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation flow.
Set the event type to RFQ.
Provide the required event title.
Choose the RFQ pricing template.
Verify that an RFQ template is applied.
Add the CYLINDER line item with the required quantity.
Render and complete the pricing sheet for the line item.
Verify the expected product and pricing columns are present.

args.goal: on the buyer create screen, set the CYLINDER line item's Delivery location to Plant Name (LOC-0001), open Savings, choose line item and Budget, enter 120 for the CYLINDER product, save the savings configuration, and stop on the create screen

steps.note: Configure the budget savings basis and value, plus the specified delivery location, using the buyer-side UI.
Commit a bidding schedule before publishing.
Invite two QA vendors so both specified bids can be submitted.
Publish the configured RFQ.
Verify that the event reached its project page.
Submit the first vendor bid at 100.
Verify that the first bid was submitted.
Submit the second vendor bid at 90.
Verify that the second bid was submitted.
Close the bidding event before opening comparison results.
Open the buyer's Master QCS after bidding has closed.
Verify that the displayed savings amount is 300.
Verify that the displayed savings percentage is 25%.
